comparison.objective: Start a clock, collect five pens into a holder, and stop the clock; unlike damper commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Button pressing and repeated small-object pick-and-place; no tool-fastener engagement, fine rotary tuning, or lock verification.
comparison.success_condition: Required start/collection/stop order, physical containment/support, and release; exact tolerances are absent and there are no spec versions.
comparison.reason: Tests timed sequencing and multi-object collection, not mechanical response adjustment.
